title: A Disk-Like CoII3DyIII4 Coordination Cluster Exhibiting Single Molecule Magnet Behavior

synthesis.procedure: HL (0.25 mmol, 0.084 g) and Et3N (0.25 mmol, 34.9 μL) were dissolved in MeOH (20 mL) with stirring to give a yellow solution. Co(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.037 g) and Dy(CF3SO3)3 (0.2 mmol, 0.122 g) were added. The orange solution was filtered and concentrated slowly almost to dryness, forming an orange precipitate. MeOH (3 mL) was added to redissolve the precipitate, and the vial was stored at room temperature. Red prismatic crystals of 1 formed after two weeks.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction in a vial; filtration and slow concentration almost to dryness, then redissolution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, concentrated almost to dryness to an orange precipitate, redissolved in MeOH (3 mL); red prismatic crystals formed after two weeks at room temperature

properties.summary: Compound 1 is a disk-like CoII3DyIII4 cluster showing SMM behavior: χMT at 300 K is 59.9 cm3 mol−1 K (expected 62.32), with a moderate decay on cooling, a small low-T upturn attributed to weak ferromagnetic interactions, then a final decay. Magnetization rises rapidly to 1 T and remains unsaturated at 5 T (25.1 electrons). Frequency-dependent ac out-of-phase signals appear below ~4 K without peaks; an applied dc field does not shift the relaxation to higher T.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, applied dc field 1 kG (0.1 T)

measurements.name: χMT (spin-only expected)
measurements.conditions: three isolated CoII and four isolated DyIII

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: fast increase to 1 T, continuous increase to 5 T

measurements.name: ac out-of-phase χM″
measurements.value: frequency-dependent signals below ~4 K; no peaks
measurements.conditions: ac field 2.5 G at 99, 400, 800, 1488 Hz; also 997 Hz, zero and 1000 G transverse field

measurements.name: dc field dependence of χMT
measurements.conditions: variable external dc fields (Figure S9, right)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: CoII3DyIII4 disk-like cluster with mixed triflate/perchlorate counterions

synthesis.procedure: Compound 2 was prepared analogously to 1: HL (0.25 mmol, 0.084 g) and Et3N (0.25 mmol, 34.9 μL) with Co(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.037 g) and Dy(CF3SO3)3 (0.2 mmol, 0.122 g), but EtOH was used instead of MeOH and the reaction was heated to reflux.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in ethanol, analogous workup to 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: synthesized analogously to 1; crystals of 2 characterized by single-crystal XRD (Pbca)

properties.summary: The paper groups 1 and 2 as disk-like CoII3DyIII4 clusters showing SMM behavior, but all quantitative dc/ac data are reported for 1; no separate numerical magnetic measurements are given for 2.
